# Little Jem

## Overview

- **Age:** 13  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** House of Dreams  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v5 c23 P49](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0049)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Little Jem  <sub>[v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Jem has curly red hair like his mother and frank hazel eyes like his father. He also inherited his mother's fine nose, his father's steady, humorous mouth, and nicely shaped ears.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)_

## Personality

Jem is a sturdy, reliable, and thoughtful boy who is not a great talker but never breaks a promise. He is deeply investigative and prefers to test statements for himself rather than taking them on faith. Known as the squarest boy in Glen St. Mary, he possesses a strong sense of fairness and rejects belief in ghosts. He is also adventuresome and harbors a strong desire to see a big battle as a soldier.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 c6 P20](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0020), [v5 c7 P31](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0031), [v5 c8 P23](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0023), [v5 c23 P66](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0066), [v5 c35 P11](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0011)_

## History

Jem was born to Anne and Gilbert Blythe at the House of Dreams before his family relocated to Ingleside. During his infancy, Captain Jim Boyd promised to leave him his museum of curiosities. As he grew up, Jem spent much of his childhood with his siblings and friends in Rainbow Valley, engaging in play, trouting, and outdoor experiments. At age thirteen, he began studying for the entrance examination of Queen's Academy, taking extra lessons after school and working in the Ingleside garret. Before departing for Charlottetown to attend Queen's Academy, Jem gathered with his companions for a final celebration in Rainbow Valley.

_Sources: [v4 c35 P41](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0041), [v4 c40 P24](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0024), [v5 c2 P1](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0001), [v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c6 P29](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0029), [v5 c23 P49](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0049), [v5 c26 P25](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0025), [v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)_
